nodes.label: Prediction-Powered Inference
nodes.author: Anastasios N. Angelopoulos, Stephen Bates, Clara Fannjiang, Michael I. Jordan, Tijana Zrnic
nodes.rationale: Framework for performing valid statistical inference combining scarce gold-standard labeled data with abundant machine-learning predictions; guarantees statistical validity without assumptions about ML algorithm.

nodes.label: Measure of Fit
nodes.rationale: Computed on unlabeled dataset imputed with predictions; quantifies how likely candidate estimand value is based on imputed data; closer to zero indicates more plausible value.

nodes.label: Rectifier
nodes.rationale: Notion of prediction error relevant for estimand of interest; defined as difference of measure of fit on labeled data versus labeled data with predicted outcomes; equals zero if predictions perfect.

nodes.label: Prediction-Powered Confidence Interval Construction
nodes.rationale: Combines measure of fit and rectifier to form valid confidence interval; guaranteed to contain true estimand at desired confidence level for any ML algorithm and data distribution.

nodes.label: Mean Estimation
nodes.rationale: Estimand for mean outcome; measure of fit is average of predictions on unlabeled data; rectifier is average prediction error on labeled data.

nodes.label: Quantile Estimation
nodes.rationale: Estimand for q-quantile of outcome; measure of fit uses sign function; rectifier measures indicator function differences.

nodes.label: Linear Regression Coefficients
nodes.rationale: Estimand for regression coefficient; measure of fit uses pseudoinverse; rectifier measures prediction error contribution.

nodes.label: Logistic Regression Coefficients
nodes.rationale: Estimand for logistic regression coefficient; measure of fit uses feature-weighted residuals; rectifier measures prediction error weighted by features.

nodes.label: Convex Risk Minimizer
nodes.rationale: General framework for any estimand expressible as minimizer of convex objective; measure of fit uses gradient; rectifier measures gradient difference.

nodes.label: Distribution Shift Handling
nodes.rationale: Framework extends to label shift and covariate shift; covariate shift handled via reweighting; label shift handled via confusion matrix estimation.

nodes.label: Proteomics Application: PTM and IDR Relationship
nodes.rationale: Used AlphaFold predictions to study posttranslational modifications in intrinsically disordered regions; prediction-powered inference required n=316 labeled observations vs n=799 for classical approach.

nodes.label: Galaxy Classification Application
nodes.rationale: Estimated fraction of galaxies with spiral arms using Galaxy Zoo 2 data; prediction-powered inference required n=189 labeled examples vs n=449 for classical approach.

nodes.label: Gene Expression Quantile Application
nodes.rationale: Constructed confidence intervals on quantiles of gene expression levels induced by promoter sequences; prediction-powered inference required n=764 labeled examples vs n=900 for classical approach.

nodes.label: Deforestation Estimation Application
nodes.rationale: Estimated fraction of Amazon rainforest lost using satellite imagery predictions; prediction-powered inference required n=21 labeled observations vs n=35 for classical approach.

nodes.label: Health Insurance Analysis Application
nodes.rationale: Investigated relationship between income and private health insurance using census data; prediction-powered inference required n=5569 labeled observations vs n=6653 for classical approach.

nodes.label: Income Analysis with Covariate Shift
nodes.rationale: Investigated relationship between age and income with distribution shift in covariates; prediction-powered inference required n=177 labeled observations vs n=282 for classical approach.

nodes.label: Plankton Counting Application
nodes.rationale: Counted plankton using ResNet predictions with label shift between years; prediction-powered inference covered ground truth while imputation approach failed.

nodes.label: Theorem S1: Validity of Prediction-Powered Inference
nodes.rationale: Main mathematical result proving prediction-powered confidence intervals contain true estimand with desired probability for any ML algorithm and data distribution.

nodes.label: Nonasymptotic Analysis
nodes.rationale: Provides nonasymptotic counterparts of main results using variance-adaptive confidence intervals; requires bounded observations within known interval.

nodes.label: General Risk Minimization
nodes.rationale: Extends framework to nonconvex losses and constrained optimization; includes applications to mode estimation, robust means, and model selection.

nodes.label: Finite Population Inference
nodes.rationale: Adapts prediction-powered inference to finite-population setting without distributional assumptions; treats population as fixed with uniform sampling of outcomes.

nodes.label: Prediction-Powered Inference
nodes.author: Angelopoulos et al.
nodes.rationale: Framework for combining machine learning predictions with labeled data to produce valid statistical inference at scale, addressing the challenge of limited labeled data in scientific applications.

nodes.label: Confidence Interval Construction
nodes.rationale: Core technical contribution: methods for constructing valid confidence intervals for mean, quantile, linear regression, and logistic regression using prediction-powered approach.

nodes.label: Finite Population Inference
nodes.rationale: Extension of prediction-powered inference to finite population settings where sampling without replacement occurs.

nodes.label: Waudby-Smith and Ramdas Confidence Intervals
nodes.author: Waudby-Smith, Ramdas
nodes.rationale: Nonasymptotic confidence interval construction with variance adaptivity, used as foundation for prediction-powered mean estimation.

nodes.label: Galaxy Zoo 2 Classification
nodes.rationale: Application domain: fine-tuning ResNet50 on galaxy morphology classification with limited labeled data.

nodes.label: Gene Expression Level Prediction
nodes.rationale: Application: predicting gene expression using transformer model with quantile regression calibration on small labeled set.

nodes.label: Amazon Deforestation Estimation
nodes.rationale: Application: estimating deforestation fraction using gradient-boosted tree predictions calibrated on gold-standard labels.

nodes.label: Income and Private Health Insurance Relationship
nodes.rationale: Application: predicting health insurance coverage from California Census data using gradient-boosted trees.
